## 1. Reproducibility Architecture & Five Substantive Verification Checks

This reference site and companion PDF brief were initiated and reviewed by **Matthew R.V. Ross** using **Google DeepMind’s Antigravity** coding agent to execute an open-source, reproducible **R (`4.5.2`) + Quarto (`1.10`)** pipeline (`src/00_setup_theme.R` through `src/05_verify_audit.R`). Five concrete engineering and accounting checks anchor every calculation:

1. **Deterministic Computation From `r nrow(manifest)` Checksummed Primary Filings:** Zero dollar amounts, headcounts, or percentages come from language-model memory. Script `01_fetch_sources.R` downloaded and SHA-256 hashed `r nrow(manifest)` primary public PDFs, governance memos, Colorado Legislative Council Blue Book fiscal notes, and federal/BLS API tables across CSU Office of Budgets, CSU IRP&E Fact Books, CDHE Budget Data Books (`Formats 20, 25, 30 & 1100–1700`), CSU System Audited Financial Statements (`FY15–FY25`), Colorado Office of the State Auditor (OSA) statutory NCAA Agreed-Upon Procedures reports (`2516F-B`, `2505F-B`), BLS CPI-U (`CUUR0000SA0`), and Urban Institute IPEDS (`2015–2023`), logging exact source URLs and page/table references in [`data/sources_manifest.csv`](data/sources_manifest.csv).
2. **Multi-Ledger Accounting Triangulation Across Independent Entities:** Every headline figure is cross-checked across independent reporting systems—reconciling CSU internal `ColOBS` division budgets (`B2 Athletics $16.91M` FY25 / `$17.15M` FY26) against Colorado State Auditor NCAA filings (`2516F-B`), `Fact Book` workforce tables against `CDHE Formats 20, 25 & 30`, Nov. 3, 2026 Colorado Blue Book fiscal notes (`Amendment 87`, `Prop NN`, `Prop 137`) against pre-election OSPB forecasts, and CSU System Financial Statements against U.S. Department of Education IPEDS series.
3. **Separating E&G Function, Title Conversions & Scale Constraints:**
   - **Isolating HR reclassifications and functional roles (`CDHE Formats 1100–1700` & continuous `FB26`):** Cross-checking `CDHE Format 20` and `CSU_Factbook_FY26.pdf` (`pp. 107–112`) controls simultaneously for `-254.6` `State Classified -> AP/Recharge` conversions, `2018–19` `Special/Temporary -> CCA` faculty rank formalization, and where E&G Non-Classified (`Admin Pro`) staff actually work—establishing that total E&G workforce (`+7.0%`, `3,506 -> 3,752`) tracked Student FTE (`+6.6%`), that `85.5%` of E&G AP staff sit in `Academic Support` (`484.1` FTE), `Instruction` (`326.4` FTE staff who teach and support labs), `Student Services` (`204.8`), `Research/Public Service` (`190.6`), and `Plant` (`50.1`), and that `Institutional Support` general admin equals `239.1` total FTE (`6.4%` of E&G FTE / `$47.50M`, falling to `187.4` FTE in `FY27 Estimate`).
   - **Testing headline cuts against `$885.16M` E&G and `$66.0M` FY28 math:** Across CSU's official FY26 E&G budget (`$885.16M`), `B2 Athletics` (`$17.15M`, `1.9%`) + `XA Debt Service` (`$31.86M`, `3.6%`) equal **5.5% of E&G (`8.0%` of 10-year E&G growth)**, and eliminating 100% of net Athletics support (`~$15.57M`) plus `$1.43M` in recent transition payouts still leaves **~76% (`~$49M–$50M/yr`)** of the projected FY28 shortfall unresolved.
4. **Disaggregating Non-E&G Research/Clinical/Agency Funds & Controlling Budget Transfers:** `Fact Book Table 123–124` isolates **69.7% (`3,205.5` of `4,597.7`) of FY25 Administrative Professional FTE funded outside E&G** (`Sponsored Programs`, `Other Funds`, `Recharge Centers`, `Auxiliaries`—plus `Prop 137`'s dedicated non-E&G `CSFS` wildfire funds). Likewise, `ColOBS` division analyses control explicitly for FY19's **\$41.64M** aid shift (`XA` to `P1`) and FY26's **~\$111.26M** pooled fringe decentralization.
5. **Public-Record Verification & Open Programmatic Assertions (`src/05_verify_audit.R`):** Claims across campus viewpoints are verified against primary public records—confirming the `$1.10M` Parsons and `$325k` Underwood settlements (`$1.43M` combined), Coach Mora's `$2.4M–$2.8M` base / `$1.5M` UConn buyout package, zero CSU employment record tying external Title IX consultant Jeff Lamoureux to Fort Collins, and post-election `Amendment 87` (`+$1.972B` FY28) / `Prop NN` (`+$521M` retained / `-$153.1M` near-term GF) impacts. Eight programmatic test groups in `src/05_verify_audit.R` verify all ledger balances, functional FTE identities, and fund partitions on every build.

*Corrections, missing primary citations, or alternative accounting interpretations from any member of the CSU community are welcomed via [`github.com/matthewross07/csu_budget_context`](https://github.com/matthewross07/csu_budget_context).*

## 2. Accounting Scope & Deflation Notes

1. **CSU System vs. Fort Collins Standalone Scope (`finstmt2015–2025` vs. `BDB`/`ColOBS`/`OSA`):**
   - **CSU System Audited Statements** combine Fort Collins, CSU Pueblo, and System/SPUR (`$644.9M` net tuition, `21.3%` discount rate, `$1,330.7M` long-term debt in FY25 + `$79.1M` STRATA ATLAS Laser bonds issued June 26, 2025).
   - **Fort Collins Standalone Scope** comes from CDHE Format 30/20 Budget Data Books (`FINAL_BDB`), CSU Office of Budgets Operating Budget Summaries (`ColOBS` + `OBS`), IRP&E Fact Books (`Tables 122–128`), and Note 5 of Colorado OSA Report `2516F-B` (`$1,118.77M` Fort Collins total debt, including `$206.96M` Athletics debt).
2. **Real-Dollar Deflation (`CPI-U`, `macro_cpiu_fy.csv`):**
   - Monthly BLS CPI-U All Urban Consumers (`CUUR0000SA0`, 2014–Oct 2026) is averaged across CSU's July–June fiscal calendar so multi-year net tuition and debt series are evaluated in constant FY25 or FY26 purchasing power (`FY27` covers `Jul–Oct 2026`).

## 3. Documented Data Gaps & Portal Blocks (`DATA_GAPS.md`)

```{r tbl-gaps}
gaps_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  `Source / Dataset` = c(
    "Knight-Newhouse Athletics Database",
    "U.S. GAO Report GAO-26-108640",
    "IRP&E Bare Domain (ir.colostate.edu)",
    "Oct. 14, 2026 Fall Forum PDF (Slides 14–15)",
    "CSU Fact Book FY27 Table 128",
    "Urban Institute IPEDS Panel"
  ),
  `Observed Constraint` = c(
    "HTTP 403 Forbidden to automated requests (anti-bot gate).",
    "HTTP 403 Forbidden when requesting full PDF from gao.gov.",
    "Bare hostname fails DNS resolution without www prefix.",
    "Public online PDF exports Slides 14–15 with blank white scenario table areas.",
    "Omits FY21–FY24 E&G-only State Classified FTE rows (reports FY15–FY20 and FY25).",
    "Harmonized Finance & HR API data run through FY23."
  ),
  `Primary Fallback / Mitigation Used` = c(
    "Colorado OSA Statutory NCAA AUP PDFs (csu_ncaa_aup_fy19..fy25, 2516F-B, and cub_ncaa_aup_fy25, 2505F-B)—the audited filings Knight-Newhouse ingests.",
    "Published summary figures (nocap_gao_26_108640_summary.html: Power-4 $120.3M vs. G5 $21.0M) paired with OSA Note 5 debt.",
    "Retrieved directly via https://www.ir.colostate.edu/.",
    "Exact $61.3M–$70.7M shortfall, ~$25M enrollment drop, and $15.112M stopgap figure sourced from Oct. 7 Memo & May 13 V4 Slide 6.",
    "Left uninterpolated in FB27 tables; continuous FY13–FY25 E&G State Classified rows (389.5, 362.2, 352.1, 339.2) cross-checked in archived CSU_Factbook_FY26.pdf (p. 112) alongside CDHE Format 25.",
    "Anchored 8-institution peer panel on FY23 IPEDS alongside FY25 statutory OSA AUP debt benchmarks."
  ),
  `Manual Reference / Verification` = c(
    "https://knightnewhousedata.org/fbs/mwc/colorado-state-university",
    "https://www.gao.gov/assets/gao-26-108640.pdf",
    "https://www.ir.colostate.edu/",
    "source_oct07_2026_early_look_budget.html; Campus-V4-5-13-2026_a-1.pdf",
    "CSU_Factbook_FY27_2026-10-22.pdf (pp. 142–147)",
    "data/processed/peer_benchmarks_2023.csv"
  )
)

csu_gt(
  gaps_tbl,
  title = "Audit Log of Upstream Portal Blocks, Posting Gaps & Accounting Boundaries",
  subtitle = "Documented in DATA_GAPS.md Without Bypassing Access Controls or Silently Interpolating Missing Cells"
)
```

## 4. Complete Primary Source Manifest (`r nrow(manifest)` Verified Files & APIs)

```{r tbl-manifest}
manifest |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    `Size (KB)` = formatC(file_bytes / 1024, format = "f", digits = 1, big.mark = ","),
    `SHA-256 (Prefix)` = substr(sha256, 1, 12)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    ID = source_id,
    Category = category,
    Title = title,
    `Fiscal Years` = fiscal_years,
    `Local Path` = rel_path,
    `Size (KB)`,
    `SHA-256 (Prefix)`,
    Status = status
  ) |>
  csu_gt(
    title = paste0("Complete Primary Source Ledger (N = ", nrow(manifest), " Verified Files & APIs)"),
    subtitle = "Every archived source is SHA-256 checksummed in data/sources_manifest.csv"
  )
```

## 5. Reproducibility Commands

To re-run the entire pipeline from scratch inside `CSU_finance/`:

```bash
# 1. Fetch/verify all 70 primary sources, parse PDFs/APIs, generate figures, and run audit assertions
Rscript src/run_all.R

# 2. Render standalone PDF brief into outputs/pdf/
quarto render report.qmd --to pdf
mv CSU_Budget_Context_FY27_28.pdf outputs/pdf/CSU_Budget_Context_FY27_28.pdf

# 3. Render static Quarto website into docs/ (configured with robots.txt + noindex headers)
quarto render
```
